title: Three more ways to make things
summary:
Three community projects joined the directory, which also got better sorting, while model labels and affiliate listings received a tidy-up.

The project directory gained NailsGen for nail-art designs, a Chinese-language FLUX image generator at imggen.top, and WebGeniusAI for generating HTML websites with Pollinations visuals.

The directory now has a Featured category and sorts projects by priority, then GitHub stars. The new-project marker applies only to submissions from the past 15 days, and DesmondBot’s listing points to its updated URL.

Draft Alpha, an AI-powered UX writing tool, was added to the affiliate list with terms covering brand voice, copywriting, and product content.
